{{Infobox map |name=Quadrunner |year=2023 |image=quadrunner_00.jpg |creator=[[Image:flag_nl.gif]] [[QuakeR]] |gametype=4on4 |size=Large }} Quadrunner (quadrunner.bsp) is a 4on4 Team Deathmatch map created by [[Image:flag_nl.gif]] [[QuakeR]]. Quaker made the map [https://www.quakeworld.nu/wiki/Locomoto Locomoto] in 2021 and Quadrunner takes the "Bladerunner theme" one step further. There are 8 spawnpoints. ===Items=== {{MapItems |quad=1 |ring=1 |pent=0 |hp100=1 |ra=1 |ya=1 |ga=1 |lg=1 |rl=2 |gl=1 |sng=1 |ng=0 |ssg=1 }}
Health : 16 (6 small, 10 normal)
Ammo : 4 rocket packs (2 big 2 normal), 2 cell packs (2x6 cells), 4 shell packs (1 big, 3 normal), 4 nailspike packs (1 big, 3 normal)
